site_notes: Former Electrolux industrial site in southwest Memphis / Paul R. Lowry Road area.
Water-reuse infrastructure proceedings identify a Colossus Water Recycling Plant at/near 3644 Riverport Road and a city land-sale parcel reported as 2685 Plant Road.

status_as_of_cutoff: As of 2026-08-11, Colossus Memphis remains treated as a major retrofit/expansion with operator-reported operations and continuing utility, air-permit, turbine, and water-reuse proceedings. Official/local-government records confirm utility support discussions, a Memphis land-sale/water-reuse proceeding, TDEC SOP-24025 water-reuse public-hearing facts, and Shelby County air-permit disputes, but no single public commissioning baseline, complete building/CO record, or verified live IT/electrical capacity was found.
evidence_grade: B: multiple official/local-government proceedings plus operator statements; live capacity and final commissioning remain unverified in public records.

actions.government_body: Memphis City Council / Memphis Light, Gas and Water
actions.result_status: The City Council agenda listed an MLGW update on support to xAI; the accompanying utility material described existing water/gas service, 8 MW initially available, a planned increase to 50 MW, and a developer-funded 150 MW substation. The agenda does not itself establish a final council vote or energized load.
actions.vote_tally: not published in the accessible agenda
actions.access_caveat: Utility-support material is not a zoning, building, air, water-operating, or CO approval; the agenda’s discussion is not treated as a vote.
actions.evidence_note: The official material is useful for proposed utility terms but not proof of actual service or commissioning.

actions.action_type: city land-sale / water-reuse plant approval proceeding
actions.result_status: Local government agenda and meeting/transcript coverage report final council approval of an $820,000 sale of about 13 acres, reported as 2685 Plant Road, to CTC Property LLC for a water-reuse facility tied to xAI/Colossus cooling. Treated as a land/water-infrastructure proceeding, not proof of completed construction or operation.
actions.vote_tally: reported as 9-1-1 in local coverage; official agenda page was accessible in search results but blocked by Cloudflare during direct fetch
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: Memphis City Council item reported as Item 15; parcel ID reported as 05010100054
actions.access_caveat: City agenda page is the official locator but direct browser/shell fetch was Cloudflare-blocked during this refresh; details cross-checked against local meeting/transcript coverage.
actions.evidence_note: Supports the water-reuse infrastructure/land-control record only; it is not a building permit, water operating permit, CO, or energization record.

actions.government_body: Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation, Division of Water Resources
actions.result_status: TDEC’s fact sheet for SOP-24025 describes the proposed Colossus Water Recycling Plant, including treatment of up to 13.5 MGD and intended reuse for xAI, TVA, and Nucor; the fact sheet does not by itself prove final operation or xAI service.
actions.access_caveat: Fact sheet/public-notice material is not a final building permit, CO, or energization record; the linked direct PDF returned 404/connection failures during this refresh, but the official TN.gov event page was accessible.
actions.evidence_note: Water-reuse proceeding is separated from the data-center building and operating status.

actions.government_body: Shelby County Health Department / Memphis and Shelby County Air Pollution Control program
actions.result_status: Public reporting and appeal filings identify Air Permit No. 01156-01PC issued to CTC Property LLC for 15 natural-gas turbines at the South Memphis xAI/Colossus site. Environmental groups appealed the permit and related temporary-turbine determinations; local reporting later said the Air Pollution Control Board dismissed the appeal 6-1 in December 2025.
actions.vote_tally: appeal dismissal reported 6-1; permit issuance vote not located in an official accessible record
actions.access_caveat: Shelby County document-center URLs for the draft permit/evaluation returned 404 during this refresh; the permit fact is therefore recorded from appeal/legal materials and local reporting rather than a directly retrieved official permit PDF.
actions.evidence_note: Air permit/turbine record supports existence of power-support proceedings and controversy; it is not proof of data-center IT load, final commissioning, or full buildout.

actions.result_status: xAI’s Memphis page states a 1-million-GPU plan by 2026 and describes collaboration with local/state officials; it does not provide a government permit, CO, commissioning certificate, or proof of the stated target being achieved.
actions.access_caveat: Operator claim is not government evidence and is not used to infer live capacity.
actions.evidence_note: Company plan, reported operations, and regulator allegations remain distinct evidence categories.

actions.government_body: SpaceXAI (operator update; non-government) / Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality referenced
actions.result_status: SpaceXAI stated that it entered an agreed order with MDEQ setting a fixed removal timeline for 69 temporary mobile turbines in Southaven, with removals beginning as early as August 2026 and all temporary turbines removed by July 2027; the same update states a 1.2 GW permanent power plant with 41 permitted turbines is under construction. Treated as adjacent cross-state power infrastructure supporting the greater Memphis-area supercomputer footprint, not as Memphis data-center capacity.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: MDEQ permit/order referenced by operator; March 2026 Permit Board minutes located
actions.access_caveat: Operator page is not government evidence; official MDEQ March 2026 Permit Board minutes PDF was located at mdeq.ms.gov but text extraction was limited because the PDF is scanned.
actions.evidence_note: Power-generation MW and turbine counts are not converted to data-center capacity_mw.

capacity_notes: MLGW material in 2024 described 8 MW initially available, a planned increase to 50 MW, and a developer-funded 150 MW substation; those figures are utility-support/proposed-service facts, not verified live IT load.

SpaceXAI's 2026 Southaven update describes a 1.2 GW permanent power plant with 41 turbines and a temporary-turbine removal timeline; this is recorded as adjacent power infrastructure and not as Memphis data-center capacity.
No official public CO, commissioning certificate, or verified live capacity record was found in this refresh.
owner: xAI / SpaceXAI operating footprint; CTC Property LLC appears in Memphis water-reuse and Shelby air-permit proceedings as the affiliated property/applicant entity.

contradictions.details: Operator pages describe Colossus as built/operational and target 1 million GPUs by 2026, while official/local-government records found in this refresh document support proceedings, permits, and infrastructure but not a single public commissioning, CO, or verified live capacity baseline.

Shelby air-permit materials and environmental-group appeals dispute the treatment of temporary turbines; the accessible record supports an unresolved/contested air-permit history rather than a clean, uncontested operating baseline.
